verdict.rationale: Bruno's own documented way to share collections with a team is Git. Collections are plain-text files on disk, and the app has a built-in Git UI for init, clone, pull, diff, commit and checking for updates, plus README buttons that open a workspace in Bruno. It explicitly rejects cloud sync, though: it is offline-only with no plans to add sync ever, so there is no automatically synced hosted shared workspace. Missing for 10: real-time or automatic cloud-synced shared workspace, team workspace management without relying on a Git remote.
